cv_text: ayv kwola tsiyvkhi tsihsa kalonetv akhstvtihskvi ale thimathi ikinhvlhi whstvywelahsi kwalmani utsathi ihstvkeyu'i ale utlhoyi tikilvwhstanehi
kathvkihskv tsatakeyuhsv ale tsohiyuhsvi nahski tsikeyuha ukvwiyhi tsihsa ale nani'v unatanhvhthi tsitehikeyuha
nahski n tsohiyuhsv tshelatihstihskvi nahski yinikvnhihsv kvnikehsv yinikalhsta nika'v ohstv kehsv itsiya'vi tsihsa kalonetv nvtikalhstohtihskvi
utsathiyhenho ulihelihsti okeha ale ukalhsti atanvhtatihsti kehsv tstakeyuhsv iyuhsti tvtikalhstohtiha unatanvthi tsuninawhi tehikalhstatehvi vkhinvlhi
utohiyuhihskininonv utsathi akiha kalonetv akhinelvi nahski kvnetsehv tsituyukhohti itsatvnehtiyi
ahsenho skikyhiyu kehsv nvtikalhstohtiha utli tsiyelvhska kvhstiyetohtiyi kwola uthvhsonhvhi iyakwahsti tsiki al khohi kehsv ayhvki tsihsa kalonetv akhstvtihskvi
nahski tsuwakthanvhsv nitsahstelihskvna tsikehsvki khohihskini tsiki tsahstelihski ale ayv akhstelihski
nahski thaline vtsinvli nahski iyuhsti nihi tehiyatanilvtsvha nahski akwhsv akinawhi tsiki
ahsenho nihi ohsiyu ntsaylvnhvna vlha yakwatulhe kohuhsti akwatvnhehtiyi nahski ohstv nhskwatvnhehv ohsiyu tsaylvnhv kvnkehsv iyulhstohtiyi vlhanho nahski ahse itsatvnhehtiyi nitsalhstanehvi
nahskiynho iyuhsti yiki lhek yutanvhsv nahski thiyatanilvihsti nikohilv utehtiyi

vtlha nhakwo atsinvhsitahsti nahskiya'i utlihskini kalvkwotiyu ehskakwo atsinvhsitahsti onvlhi akeyuhi nahskiya'i ayv ho ukvwiyuha tsikeyu'i nihihskini nika'v utlihiyu hikeyu'i nahski na ukwetlhi kehsv ale ukvwiyuhi tehstanelhohtvi
nahski iyuhsti iyunho okinathkwlohi skwelihsehehsti tehiyatanilvtsvha ayv tsitehskwatanilvko nahskiya'i
ayv kwola akwhsv akwoyen kvta kowelvka ayv takkuyvhi vlhahskininon tsvhsv kehsv nahskwo kvthuka tihskwatayohihsehtiyi yikvyohseha
tsohiyuhsv akwalhskahstohtv wikvyowelanelvki tsikathahvki nahskwo tsalohsvhstohtiyi kehsv nhatvnehv nuhstv knetsehvi
ale nahskwo skwatnvihstanelvha skhskwankotohtiyi uthukiyheno akwvha itsatatolihstihskv iywanhihsohtiyi thalin witsvluhtsehtiyi
